_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / tool-rendering-reasoning-chain. Each of the three pills drives a chained two-tool flow (stocks AAPL->MSFT, dice d20->d6, flights SFO->JFK then JFK weather) with a `reasoning` field on both tool legs, which aimock replays as Gemini thought parts and the adapter surfaces as REASONING_* events.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: Restaged from toolCallId chains onto turnIndex: the Antigravity Go harness never sends role:"tool" messages (see PARITY_NOTES.md), so leg k sits at turnIndex base+2k and the narration at base+4. The d5 probe and the e2e 'sequential pills' test run stocks, dice, flights in ONE thread, so the dice and flights ladders are repeated at offsets 5 and 10. Tool legs carry no `content`: see PARITY_NOTES.md for whether a text part on a tool leg moves the count.

fixtures._comment: Pill 1 'Compare two stocks', fresh thread AND first pill of the one-thread sequence (probe + sequential e2e test): get_stock_price(AAPL) at 0, get_stock_price(MSFT) at 2, narration at 4. The prompt also contains the bare 'AAPL' that tool-rendering.json stages at 0/2; this file sorts before tool-rendering.json ('-' < '.'), so it wins the turnIndex-0 tie, and 2/4 win outright. Every tool leg carries `reasoning` so each turn mounts a reasoning block.
